Weather Forecasts Issued for Cochin and Other Indian Regions

Multiple Indian news outlets have published weather forecasts for various regions. Hindustan provided a weather update for Cochin, detailing the conditions for Saturday, June 27th, and a five-day outlook. Amar Ujala released a general weather forecast for June 29th, 2026, indicating expected conditions across different areas. These reports aim to inform the public about upcoming weather patterns.

How outlets across the spectrum covered it

  • Centre (7): Amar Ujala, Dainik Bhaskar, Hindustan (Hindi), Patrika, The Free Press Journal, The Lallantop, The Times of India
  • Right (6): Aaj Tak, Dainik Jagran, News18 Hindi, Punjab Kesari, The Pioneer, Zee News (Hindi)
